events.verdict: Watkins (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nets.
Riley (WAS) briefly places his hand momentarily on Powell's (BKN) side as they navigate the screen.
Scott (BKN) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Gill (WAS) firms up over his right leg in Traore's (BKN) path prior to the contact.
Liddell (BKN) initiates contact with Reese's (WAS) arm that affects his ability to control the ball.
Riley (WAS) briefly grasps Traore's (BKN) arm, which causes Traore to momentarily lose control of the ball.
Traore (BKN) leaves his feet to pass and he releases the ball before he returns to the floor.
Riley (WAS) is moving alongside Wilson's (BKN) path as he defends the drive.
Reese (WAS) and Wilson (BKN) come together at the same spot in the air, and the contact as Wilson passes the ball is marginal.

Watkins (WAS) commits a take foul on Traore (BKN).
